in_arabic.name: بَصَرَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: البصيرة هي نور العقل الذي يرشح الإنسان للاختيار الصحيح، وقد سميت ببصرة لأنها تظهر لمن يحتضر من بين قوسين، وسميت بسمراء لأنها تبرز في نور الخضراء، وتسمى كذلك بسمراء لأنها تنبع من نور الخضراء، وتسمى بسمراء لأنها تنبع من نور الخضراء، وهو ما يشير إلى أن البصيرة هي نور العقل الذي يرشح الإنسان للاختيار الصحيح، وهو ما يظهر في سورة الفاتحة حيث قال تعالى: {وَبِصِرَةٍ تَقضي بِالْحَقِّ} [الفتحة: 17]

in_english.name: Basrat
in_english.meaning: Source of insight and understanding, guiding individuals to make wise decisions
in_english.long_meaning: Basrat is a term that refers to the source of insight and understanding, which guides individuals to make wise decisions. Insight is a crucial aspect of human life, and it plays a significant role in helping individuals make informed decisions. In Islamic tradition, Basrat is considered an essential quality that enables individuals to distinguish between right and wrong, and to make choices that align with their values and principles. It is associated with the ability to discern truth from falsehood, and to make decisions that are guided by wisdom and discernment. The term Basrat is derived from the Arabic root "basr," which means "to discern" or "to see." In Islamic context, Basrat is often used to describe the ability to see beyond the surface level and to perceive the deeper meaning and reality of things.
